column1: # Stage B of the refactor program (#2062): where each item of src/session_host.rs goes.
# One row per item, in file order. pr 0 means the item stays in session_host.rs; the others
# move to src/session_host/<file>.rs in that PR. kind, impl and name are as
# `scripts/move_items.py --target session_host --check` after adding an item to session_host.rs.
# session_host.rs keeps the structs whose private fields more than one of its parts reads:
# the host, its clients, the swap handoff, a client's outbox and the inner channel.
